# 配置管理指南

## 配置文件位置

默认位置：项目根目录的 `config.toml`

可通过环境变量覆盖：

```bash
export CONFIG_PATH=/path/to/custom/config.toml
```

## 配置加载

### 获取全局配置

```rust
use yu::config::get_config;

let config = get_config();  // 懒加载，只初始化一次

// 访问配置项
if let Some(db_config) = &config.database {
    println!("DB path: {:?}", db_config.path);
}
```

### 配置结构

```rust
#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct AppConfig {
    #[serde(rename = "proxyUrl")]
    pub proxy_url: Option<String>,
    
    pub database: Option<DuckDBConfig>,
    
    #[serde(rename = "logLevel")]
    pub log_level: Option<String>,
    
    pub binance_websocket: Option<BinanceWebSocketConfig>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct DuckDBConfig {
    pub path: Option<String>,
}
```

## 数据库配置

### DuckDB

```toml
[database]
path = "data/market.duckdb"  # 文件路径，留空则使用内存数据库
```

### 通过环境变量

```bash
export YU_DATABASE_PATH="data/market.duckdb"
```

## 网络配置

### HTTP 代理

```toml
proxyUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:7891"
```

### 环境变量

```bash
export YU_PROXY_URL="http://127.0.0.1:7891"

# 或标准代理变量（优先级低）
export HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:7891"
export HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:7891"
```

### WebSocket 代理

WebSocket 客户端会自动读取：

```rust
pub fn new_with_env_proxy(url: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
    let proxy = std::env::var("WS_PROXY")
        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("HTTPS_PROXY"))
        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("HTTP_PROXY"))
        .ok();
    
    // ...
}
```

优先级：`WS_PROXY` > `HTTPS_PROXY` > `HTTP_PROXY`

## 日志配置

### 日志级别

```toml
logLevel = "info"  # 可选值: "off", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", "trace"
```

### 通过环境变量

```bash
export YU_LOG_LEVEL="debug"
```

### 代码中配置

```rust
use li::tools::logs::setup_logger;
use log::LevelFilter;
use std::collections::HashMap;

let mut special_log = HashMap::new();
special_log.insert("yu".to_string(), LevelFilter::Trace);      // yu 模块用 Trace
special_log.insert("li".to_string(), LevelFilter::Trace);      // li 模块用 Trace
special_log.insert("yue".to_string(), LevelFilter::Debug);     // yue 模块用 Debug

setup_logger(
    Some(LevelFilter::Warn),   // 默认日志级别
    special_log                 // 特定模块配置
)?;
```

## WebSocket 配置

### 完整配置

```toml
[binance_websocket]

# 现货流数据（市场数据）
[binance_websocket.spot_stream]

# 成交数据
[binance_websocket.spot_stream.trade]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT", "BNBUSDT"]
batch_size = 100              # 缓冲区大小
flush_interval_ms = 5000      # 刷新间隔
retention_days = 7            # 保留天数

# 深度数据
[binance_websocket.spot_stream.depth]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT"]
update_speed = "100ms"        # "100ms" 或 "1000ms"
levels = 20                   # 5, 10, 20 或 none

# 现货账户流（需要 API Key）
[binance_websocket.spot]

[[binance_websocket.spot.accounts]]
account_name = "account1"
api_key = "your_api_key"
key_path = "/path/to/private_key"

[[binance_websocket.spot.accounts]]
account_name = "account2"
api_key = "another_api_key"
key_path = "/path/to/another_key"
```

### 最小配置

```toml
[binance_websocket.spot_stream.trade]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT"]

[binance_websocket.spot_stream.depth]
enabled = false
symbols = []
```

## 配置项详解

### SpotTradeStreamConfig

```rust
#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SpotTradeStreamConfig {
    pub enabled: Option<bool>,           // 默认 true
    pub symbols: Vec<String>,            // 必须大写，如 BTCUSDT
    pub batch_size: Option<usize>,       // 默认 100
    pub flush_interval_ms: Option<u64>,  // 默认 1000
    pub retention_days: Option<u32>,     // 默认 7
}

impl SpotTradeStreamConfig {
    pub fn batch_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.batch_size.unwrap_or(100)
    }
}
```

### SpotDepthStreamConfig

```rust
#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SpotDepthStreamConfig {
    pub enabled: Option<bool>,           // 默认 true
    pub symbols: Vec<String>,
    pub update_speed: Option<String>,    // 默认 "100ms"
    pub levels: Option<u32>,             // 默认 20
}

impl SpotDepthStreamConfig {
    pub fn update_speed(&self) -> String {
        self.update_speed.clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "100ms".to_string())
    }
    
    pub fn levels(&self) -> u32 {
        self.levels.unwrap_or(20)
    }
}
```

## 环境变量覆盖

配置项可通过环境变量覆盖，格式：`YU_<PATH_TO_KEY>`

```bash
# 覆盖数据库路径
export YU_DATABASE_PATH="data/custom.duckdb"

# 覆盖日志级别
export YU_LOG_LEVEL="debug"

# 覆盖代理
export YU_PROXY_URL="http://proxy.example.com:8080"
```

嵌套配置使用 `_` 分隔：

```bash
# binance_websocket.spot_stream.trade.symbols
export YU_BINANCE_WEBSOCKET_SPOT_STREAM_TRADE_SYMBOLS="BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT"
```

## 配置验证

### 测试配置加载

```rust
#[test]
fn test_config_loading() {
    let config = Config::builder()
        .add_source(config::File::with_name("tests/config_test/config_all.yaml"))
        .build()
        .expect("Failed to build config");
    
    let app_config: AppConfig = config
        .try_deserialize()
        .expect("Failed to deserialize config");
    
    assert!(app_config.binance_websocket.is_some());
    
    let spot_stream = &app_config.binance_websocket
        .unwrap()
        .spot_stream
        .unwrap();
    
    assert!(spot_stream.trade.is_some());
    assert_eq!(
        spot_stream.trade.unwrap().symbols.len(),
        3
    );
}
```

## 常见配置错误

### 1. 交易对未大写

```toml
# ✗ 错误
symbols = ["btcusdt", "ethusdt"]

# ✓ 正确
symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT"]
```

### 2. 路径问题

```toml
# ✗ 错误（相对路径容易出问题）
path = "data/market.duckdb"

# ✓ 正确（使用绝对路径或环境变量）
path = "/absolute/path/to/market.duckdb"
```

### 3. 遗漏必要配置

```toml
# ✓ 最小可用配置
[binance_websocket.spot_stream.trade]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT"]

[binance_websocket.spot_stream.depth]
enabled = false
symbols = []
```

## 配置示例文件

### config.toml（完整）

```toml
# 代理配置
proxyUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:7891"

# 数据库配置
[database]
path = "data/market.duckdb"

# 日志配置
logLevel = "info"

# 币安 WebSocket 配置
[binance_websocket]

# 市场数据流
[binance_websocket.spot_stream]

[binance_websocket.spot_stream.trade]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT", "BNBUSDT"]
batch_size = 100
flush_interval_ms = 5000
retention_days = 7

[binance_websocket.spot_stream.depth]
enabled = true
symbols = ["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT"]
update_speed = "100ms"
levels = 20

# 账户流
[binance_websocket.spot]

[[binance_websocket.spot.accounts]]
account_name = "trading_account"
api_key = "${API_KEY}"
key_path = "/etc/secrets/ed25519_key"
```

## 安全建议

### 敏感信息管理

```bash
# ✓ 好做法：使用环境变量
export YU_BINANCE_WEBSOCKET_SPOT_ACCOUNTS_0_API_KEY="xxx"
export YU_BINANCE_WEBSOCKET_SPOT_ACCOUNTS_0_KEY_PATH="/secure/path"

# ✓ 好做法：使用密钥管理系统
# 读取密钥时从 AWS Secrets Manager、HashiCorp Vault 等

# ✗ 不好：在代码中硬编码
# ✗ 不好：将敏感信息提交到 Git
```

### 配置文件权限

```bash
chmod 600 config.toml        # 仅所有者可读
chmod 600 /etc/secrets/*     # 私钥文件权限
```
